The '''Graveyard of Heroes''' is located in the south-western part of [[Shayzien]]. The [[Shayzien church|city's church]] is found here, and is filled with ceremonial pillars representing the soldiers who have perished in the line of duty. In the north-west corner, a gravestone with a rose engraved next to the lancalliums can be found. This gravestone belongs to [[Rose]]'s mother, who died in childbirth.

Those who have added [[History and Hearsay]] to [[Kharedst's memoirs]] ([[Tale of the Righteous]] completion required) may teleport here using the book. On occasion, gang meetings take place here while players [[Intelligence Gathering|tackle organised crime]].

A large monument can be found at the end of the passageway east of the church. Here, an [[Old man (Shayzien)|old man]] can be seen reminiscing his days in the army. [[New Recruit Tony]] can be found walking around south-east of the Graveyard of Heroes.

In the south-west corner, the entrance to the [[Shayzien Crypts]], accessed during [[Dragon Slayer II]], houses the tombs of Kourend's royalty from decades past, though it is now overrun by undead. At the bottom of the crypt is [[Camorra Shayzien]]'s tomb, alongside an unknown tomb that has collapsed into the ground further below.

==Trivia==
* The [[ceremonial pillar]]s in the graveyard contain Japanese phrases, which are turned upside down.
** "彼が死んだ" - "He died."
** "猿も木から落ちる" - "Even monkeys fall from trees." (a Japanese proverb)
* The large monument is mixed with Traditional and Simplified Chinese words, which are also turned upside down.
** "一騎当千万式戦争" - "One rider can battle in thousands upon thousands of battles."
** The phrase could also be translated as "A style of war where a single rider equals thousands upon thousands."
